title: Video of Townsend Brown celebrating at UNC Chapel Hill
place_text: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: There are even videos of Townsen Brown at the University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, celebrating because his experiments presumably worked.

plain: There are videos, it is said, of the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown celebrating at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in the 1950s, because his experiments had "presumably worked." Michels tells this himself in an episode about Brown, without naming the footage or saying which experiments they were. If true, it would show that Brown believed, at least for a moment, that his work had succeeded.
